source: D&D 5e Player's Handbook (2014), Table 13: Armor, 'Strength (Str)' column
notes: 5e-SRD-Equipment.json disagrees with the PHB for three entries: it reports chain-mail Str 13 (PHB: 15), ring-mail Str 0 (PHB: 13), and half-plate-armor Str 0 (PHB: 13).
These overrides exist because Armour Class and carrying capacity both depend on the Strength requirement, so the SRD values would let a character illegally wear plate armour.
Only strMinimum is overridden; baseAC, dexBonus and stealthDisadvantage in the SRD match the PHB.
